items.heading: Amiwo
details: Key ingredients: corn flour, tomato sauce, chili, fish or chicken
Cook a rich tomato and chili sauce with grilled fish or chicken.
Whisk corn flour into boiling water, stirring constantly until smooth and thick.
Continue cooking the corn dough until it pulls away from the pot.
Serve the dough with the tomato sauce and fish spooned over.

items.heading: Wagasi Fry
details: Key ingredients: wagasi cheese, tomato, onion, pepper, oil
Slice local wagasi cheese into thick pieces.
Fry the cheese slices in hot oil until lightly browned.
Saute tomato, onion and pepper into a quick sauce.
Serve the fried cheese topped with the pepper sauce.
